app.name: Texas Hold'Em Lava Dome
app.long_description:
The world's most social card game, played completely alone. An escalating ante drains your stack every round and your hand is scored against a threshold that climbs with it. Bank what you win or press your luck: escape the dome with your chips, or lose the lot.
Built with magnolia, a Wii homebrew game engine by magmacrunch.
